The event is `member.joined`, published by `invitation-service.ts:153` when an invitation is accepted. Two files register handlers for it:

- `src/server/services/usage-service.ts:89` (increments seat usage)
- `src/server/services/notification-service.ts:231` (notifies the org owner)

Both files import repository modules directly through the `@/server/repositories/...` alias. There are no relative repository imports in either file. Those imports are:

- `usage-service.ts`: `organization-repository.ts`, `usage-repository.ts`
- `notification-service.ts`: `issue-repository.ts`, `notification-repository.ts`, `organization-repository.ts`, `notification-preference-repository.ts`

This lists only what the two files import directly. It does not follow what `notify()` or the other helpers reach indirectly.
